concerns.text: FR-003 mandates Ω_ij "MUST be sourced from NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables (2022 edition)". T003 weakens this to "real published/calculated Miedema-type or thermodynamic-table values". This is a silent source relaxation of a provenance requirement the spec's predictor-independence assumption depends on. Either restore the NIST-JANAF 2022 sourcing or amend the spec explicitly.

Spec assumption: "a feature selection step is not mandatory (the model relies on the full set of engineered features)". T005 mandates within-CV L1/RFE selection with a hard `COMPLEMENTARITY_FAILURE` halt — a new failure mode the spec never authorized. The plan introduced it; the task list should either drop the mandatory halt or the spec must be amended to sanction it.

SC-002 says "no hard pass/fail threshold is imposed" with a ~45 MPa reference, but T008 conforms to results.schema.yaml whose `practical_utility.mae_vs_threshold` is defined as "True if MAE <= 50 MPa" — a de-facto threshold at an inconsistent value (50 vs ~45). T006 correctly treats SC-002 as a reported comparison; T008's schema conformance reintroduces the gate. Reconcile the contract or the task.

T002 claims bcc_filtered.csv/bcc_aggregated.csv conform to bcc_alloy.schema.yaml (SC-005), but the schema requires `yield_definition`, `source_reference`, and `processing_status` (additionalProperties: false) and T002's description and tests never mention populating or validating these fields. As written the deliverable will fail its own stated conformance check.

"results are non-deterministic-free (fixed seed reproduces identical values)" is garbled phrasing of the determinism requirement; restate as "results are deterministic: fixed seed reproduces identical values" so the verification is unambiguous.
